requirements.text: 3–8 years of professional frontend or software engineering experience, including ownership of production web applications
Advanced proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and substantial experience building applications with React
Experience with Next.js or a comparable modern frontend framework, including routing, server-side rendering, or hybrid rendering patterns
Strong understanding of browser fundamentals, responsive design, accessibility standards, web performance, and frontend security
Hands-on experience integrating REST or GraphQL services and managing client-side state with tools such as React Query, Redux, or equivalent
Experience writing automated tests and working with Git-based development workflows, CI pipelines, and code review practices

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; Bonus: experience with design systems, mobile web optimization, data visualization, or native mobile development
